text:
alex: quick flag from this morning's interviewer shadowing: several interviewers got two different scorecards for the same candidate in under 2 minutes. one had the new 'impact' rubric, the other showed the legacy 'results' rubric. super confusing in panel debriefs.

keisha: oh no. did the ATS send two create events or was this a UI refresh issue?

ats-sync-bot: webhook: interview.created id=98122 version=4 received at 2026-02-05T09:20:10Z

michael: digging in. i see a replay: ATS sent an update event ~90s after create with `scorecard_version: v4`, but our web client cached v3 for 120s and didn't pick up the update in time. the timing window is the issue.

tara: that explains why panelists who joined later saw v4. impact: 6 panels, 3 debriefs submitted with mixed rubrics. we need to freeze debrief submissions for impacted interviews until we reconcile.

alex: can we surface a banner in the UI when a scorecard update arrives within X minutes of interview start? at least interviewers know to wait.

michael: short-term mitigations: 1) set client cache TTL to 30s for scorecards 2) add a UI banner when a recent update exists 3) people-ops to notify affected panels to pause debriefs.

people-ops-bot: created ticket RECRUIT-2207 "scorecard race: ATS update arrives after client cache" assigned to michael,keisha

keisha: i'll message the schedulers now and pause debrief submissions for the six affected interviews. alex, can you DM the hiring managers with a template?

alex: on it. will send the standard "hold submissions" note and include link to the canonical rubric in Drive.

michael: longer-term: propose we add a version-check in the interview creation flow. if ATS version != served config version, block auto-send of invites and surface a warning to schedulers. I'll draft a tiny spec.

tara: also adding: onboarding/training note for interviewers: "If rubric changes within 5 minutes of start, pause and wait for ops message." we'll include screenshots in the playbook.

keisha: i ran a quick audit: affected interview IDs: 98117, 98122, 98125, 98130, 98135, 98140. posting secure list to ops channel.

michael: patched client TTL to 30s and pushed UI banner to staging. will roll to prod after quick smoke.

ats-sync-bot: webhook: scorecard.refresh v4 broadcast at 2026-02-05T09:21:41Z

keisha: schedulers notified, debriefs paused. thanks for the fast turnaround.

alex: follow-ups: 1) eng to implement pre-send version check (RECRUIT-2208) 2) people-ops to add training blurb + attach canonical rubric to all calibration invites for next month 3) eng to add an integration test simulating delayed ATS update.

people-ops-bot: created follow-up tasks RECRUIT-2208, RECRUIT-2209, RECRUIT-2210

tara: marking this resolved for now. will reopen if any debriefs were finalized incorrectly. :white_check_mark:
